ddl.value: "bkt_p_init" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "bkt_p_learn" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "bkt_p_guess" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "bkt_p_slip" BETWEEN 0 AND 1
ddl.name: skills_bkt_range_check

ddl.value: "status" = 'in_review' OR ("reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: publication_decision_check

ddl.value: "status" NOT IN ('changes_requested','rejected') OR "review_note" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: publication_reason_check

ddl.value: "starts_at" IS NULL OR "expires_at" IS NULL OR "expires_at" > "starts_at"
ddl.name: vouchers_window_check

ddl.value: "status" <> 'resolved' OR ("resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: conversations_resolved_check

ddl.value: "lecturer_reply" IS NULL OR ("replied_by" IS NOT NULL AND "replied_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: course_reviews_reply_check

ddl.value: ("prompt_tokens" IS NULL OR "prompt_tokens" >= 0) AND ("completion_tokens" IS NULL OR "completion_tokens" >= 0)
ddl.name: ai_logs_tokens_check
